query: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.address, d.port, d.machine_id, m.intermittent, (SELECT h.id FROM repo_hosts h WHERE h.machine_id = d.machine_id) AS "repo_host_id?", m.wake_enabled, m.wake_mac_address, m.wake_broadcast_address, m.wake_timeout_seconds, w.mode AS "mode?: MachineWakeMode" FROM dependency_hosts d JOIN machines m ON m.id = d.machine_id LEFT JOIN schedule_machine_wake w ON w.schedule_id = $1 AND w.machine_id = d.machine_id WHERE d.id IN (SELECT dependency_host_id FROM schedule_dependencies WHERE schedule_id = $1 AND agent_id = $2 UNION SELECT dependency_host_id FROM agent_default_dependencies WHERE agent_id = $2 UNION SELECT rd.dependency_host_id FROM repo_host_dependencies rd JOIN repos r ON r.repo_host_id = rd.repo_host_id JOIN schedule_repos sr ON sr.repo_id = r.id WHERE sr.schedule_id = $1) ORDER BY d.name
